content:
Create a premium, visually immersive, high-converting landing page for a fictional luxury residential project in Gurugram.

PROJECT IDENTITY
Project name: AURELIA House
Developer: Fictional concept by Aurelia Living
Location: Gurugram, Haryana
Project status: Fictional design concept, not a real or registered property
Price: On Request
RERA: Not applicable — fictional concept
Unit sizes, possession date, approvals, travel times, and amenities: Not supplied; do not invent them. Use “Details on request” where needed.

IMPORTANT FACTUAL RULES
This is an imaginary showcase project for design demonstration only. Do not present it as a real property, claim that it is registered, or invent legal, pricing, construction, or location facts.
Do not use facts, images, maps, contacts, RERA details, or branding from Prestige Parklane or any other existing project.
Do not fabricate distances or name specific nearby landmarks.
Use clearly labeled illustrative architectural imagery or elegant CSS image treatments. Do not imply generated imagery depicts an actual building.

VISUAL DIRECTION
Create an original visual identity called “Contemporary Urban Sanctuary”: refined, cinematic, architectural, private, and metropolitan. Aim for the feel of an international architecture magazine and luxury-hotel campaign, not a conventional property advertisement.

COLOR PALETTE
Midnight navy #0B1F33
Deep navy #071522
Pearl #F4F1EA
Soft pearl #E8E4DA
Neutral grey #8A8D91
Dark slate #343B42
Burnt clay #B85C45
Muted copper #A77B5A
White #FFFFFF

Use navy for depth, pearl for calm backgrounds, and copper sparingly for accents. Avoid neon, saturated colors, generic black-and-gold styling, and yellow gradients.

PAGE DESIGN
Build a complete, responsive, accessible single-page landing page with:
- A cinematic blue-hour hero featuring an illustrative contemporary Gurugram residence, clear project name, and “Fictional concept” label.
- Editorial introduction and project vision.
- Design-led sections for arrival, architecture, interiors, landscape, clubhouse, wellness, and lifestyle.
- Gallery with varied architectural compositions and image ratios.
- Location section labeled “Gurugram concept location”; show no map pin, commute time, or named landmark.
- Pricing and project details that say “On Request” or “Details on request.”
- FAQs that clearly distinguish concept imagery from verified property information.
- Enquiry form with a clear demo notice; do not invent a phone number, email, or sales office.
- Responsive navigation, accessible controls, and restrained motion.

IMAGE DIRECTION
Use consistent editorial architectural imagery: realistic stone, glass, concrete, timber, natural light, accurate perspective, and subtle blue-hour lighting. Keep buildings believable and avoid distorted windows, fantasy towers, fake logos, watermarks, text in images, and recognizable developer branding. Make the images feel illustrative rather than documentary.

DELIVERY
Return a complete HTML5 page with embedded CSS and vanilla JavaScript. Use the palette in the actual design. Make navigation and interactions work. Keep all project claims clearly fictional and do not copy another developer’s page, branding, images, or text.
The landing page for **AURELIA House** is ready. I used the fictional concept details in your brief, your design brief, and the LandingPageAgent skill with OpenCode.
